text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Consultation meeting held on May 3, 2018 and the issues raised by community members at that meeting. Leading the meeting was Councillor Layton, Board Member and Co-host for the meeting. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Dianne Young, Chief Executive Officer, Mark Goss, General Manager, Operations and Debbie Sanderson, Executive Assistant to the Chief Executive Officer. Representatives from the Toronto Police Service Community Response Unit; Toronto Paramedic Services; Toronto Fire Services; and City Parks, Forestry and Recreation; were invited and in attendance. There were 10 members of the community attending. The meeting lasted approximately two hours with active participation by the community.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Directed the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, in consultation with Toronto Police Service and the local Councillors, to report to the Board on the implementation of a traffic and parking enforcement plan for the immediate area, including enhancement during Toronto FC and Toronto Argonauts games and the Canadian National Exhibition.
